description: Manages per-project tool versions (Node.js, Python, Go, Rust, Ruby and hundreds more), environment variables and tasks from one mise.toml file, as a single binary that replaces nvm, pyenv, rbenv and asdf. Use when a user asks to pin Node.js/Python/Go versions per project, replace nvm/pyenv/asdf, share tool requirements with a team or CI, lock resolved versions, or define project tasks.
